sentences.text: 27.07.2022 Shri Abhishek Saraf, counsel for the appellant.
Shri Afroj Khan, P.L. for the State/respondent.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant was found guilty for the offence punishable under Section 52 of Chhattisgarh Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and he was punished with a fine of Rs. 1,00,000/- by the Additional District Magistrate and Adjudicating Officer which was challenged before Sessions Judge/ Appeal Tribunal (Food Safety Appeal Tribunal)
and the same was confirmed.

sentences.text: He prays for admission of this appeal with a deposition of 25 per cent of the fine amount.

This appeal is admitted for hearing subject to deposition of 25 per cent of the fine amount i.e. Rs.
1,00,000/-.
List the case for final hearing.
